system.description:
When the moment is right to press your advantage, you can unleash a barrage of attacks. Make a weapon attack light deed or attempt a maneuver. You can use this ability in addition to the attempt deed action on your turn, exceeding your normal limit of one deed per turn.

You can use this ability up to three times in a combat, but successive onslaughts draw upon your reserves of strength. To use this ability a second time, you must spend two recovery dice. To use it a third time, you must spend two points of endurance.
